warning.titlePre: Mercedes GLA220d Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your GLA220d is a 2013–2020 model with the OM651 diesel — that's the X156 generation — timing chain wear and injector seal leaks are a well-documented pattern on this engine, shared with the A-Class family. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, and injector seals as standard on every OM651 rebuild.
The H247 generation (2020–present) uses a different engine, the OM607, which doesn't share this specific issue. We don't have a confirmed pattern for the OM607 in this model at this time.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern (per G-BRF), verified via VRF. OM607 (H247) explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to generation
